ABOUT MADINA QURAAN ACADEMY

About Madina Quraan Academy

Madina Quraan Academy is dedicated to providing authentic, structured and easy-to-understand Islamic education for Muslim girls and children. Our aim is to nurture a generation that loves the Qur’an, follows the right path and builds a strong connection with Allah.
